paper_title: First results from the Axion Dark-Matter Birefringent Cavity (ADBC) experiment
notes: ADBC birefringent optical cavity ALP search. Five datasets centered at cavity splitting frequencies 10.03, 10.30, 12.07, 13.27, 13.54 MHz (masses ~41.5-56 neV), covering ranges 40.9-43.3, 49.3-50.6, 54.4-56.7 neV. Average 95% CL limit g_agamma <= 1.9e-8 GeV^-1 applied at the five dataset masses; individual dataset limits vary somewhat (roughly 1e-8 to 1e-7 in Fig 3) but only the average is quoted numerically.
